module: Small manager of ambient sound "streams" played in the 'AudioGui' audio channel. Each stream is described by a JSON file (key data) containing a list of sounds and a random delay between two plays. update(dt) must be called by the caller every frame: it plays a randomly drawn sound, waits for the sound to end plus the delay, then draws another.
notes: Bug: in getRandomSound, the "delay with 1 value" and "no delay" branches write to the nonexistent variable temptable (nil) instead of stream.currentSoundData: this triggers a Lua error. Only the delay = {min, max} case works.
Bug: if a stream has only one sound, the second call of getRandomSound loops forever (repeat … until previousSound ~= temp can never be true).
The volume is hardcoded to 0.29 in update; stream.volume is never used for playback. The fadeInTime parameter of setStreamState is ignored (stream.fadeInTime is never set by this module).
update does not check that currentSoundData exists: a stream without sounds will make getRandomSound fail right from init.
The module does not call itself: no onUpdate hook is exported, so the caller must invoke ui_ambientSound.update(dt).

init.desc: Loads a sound stream JSON file (key data), adds it to the list of streams, draws a first sound at random and returns the stream ID. If the file does not exist, logs an error and returns nothing.

json.desc: Path of the JSON file describing the stream (field data with sounds, delay…).

returns.desc: streamID of the new stream, or nil if the file is not found.

update.desc: Advances all streams: plays the current sound if it exists (FS:fileExists) via Engine.Audio.playOnce('AudioGui'), then accumulates time and moves to a new sound when duration + delay have elapsed.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the previous frame, in seconds.

deleteSoundSFX.desc: Removes from the list the stream whose streamID matches.

setStreamState.desc: Sets the volume and pitch of a stream. fadeInTime is accepted but not used.

volume.desc: Volume stored in the stream (not used at playback, see notes).
